_readme: Canonical index of Wavlake tracks in the stream rotation. file paths are relative to storage/app/stream/music/ on the server. zap_route wavlake-keysend: the artist has no npub on Wavlake; zaps route through Wavlake's node (customKey 16180339) - the QR target is the track page, where every Nostr wallet pays the artist. Append new imports here; the slides build from this file. Nostr zap addresses were found over the artists' Nostr profiles (kind-0 verified): where a lightning address exists the qr_target is that lud16 (zap the artist directly); with only an npub the qr_target is the njump profile page. Artists without any nostr presence keep the wavlake track page as target.
